resourceWarningPolicy: Only same-origin GET /favicon.ico HTTP 404 and its exact Chromium console message are retained as warnings; all other failures block the run. Console classification does not depend on response event ordering.
limitations: Earlier campaign chapters, independent branch preparation and Noveria combat victories are declared native fixtures; no combat completion is claimed played here.
Synthetic Insights retrieval is a condensed terminal interaction without the original ERCS/Kaira battles or complete hotel/office geography.
Lorik persuasion visibly uses adapted morality thresholds; the original ME1 Charm/Intimidate talents remain absent.
The Opold fast route is exercised; the complete contraband assignment, Inamorda outcomes and variable gains are not implemented by this lot.
The queen conversations and decisions are played publicly. Quarantine, hot laboratories, full original cinematics and later Mass Effect campaigns remain outside this proof.
Native fixture preparation and any position transfer are explicitly declared and are not claimed played in this browser.
Only actual public DOM readings, keyboard/mouse controls, imports and exports are used; no private browser state, clock, HP, DOM or style assignment.
Current functional scenes do not certify full original geography, dialogue, artwork, hardware or native Windows compatibility.
